headline: ADVENTURE drives itself: the 1979 chalice run goes on the Y key
lede: Watch batch 11 seats ADVENTURE's proven route — press Y and the cart walks the classic solve (black key, gate rite, bridge, white key, chalice, home) across all three cart variants. Any input takes over instantly; the guide declines honestly when it runs out of proven road. Defender and Pac-Man stay 'no guide yet' — their attract demos cheat or wander, and we ship proofs, not theater. Coverage: 48 titles.

notes.text: route.js is the harness's own driver: the same generator wins 30/30 node-live runs (10 seeds x 3 variants, bat-theft recoveries included) that the browser seats live — seat equals proof.
The guide may only emit inputs: a new gate greps it for world-writes, so no teleport guides. V1/V2's waypoint script had its teleports replaced with real drives.
A halt is on the board (#1840) — lanes finish the step and stop until Jon lifts it.

look.text: Watch the chalice run — Y seats the route mid-quest
